response.sql:
WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceId,
    r.name AS race_name,
    AVG(cr.points) AS average_points,
    COUNT(*) AS result_count
  FROM constructorResults AS cr
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
  WHERE cr.points > 1.0
  GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    raceId,
    race_name,
    average_points,
    result_count,
    average_points / AVG(average_points) OVER (PARTITION BY race_name) AS ratio
  FROM race_averages
)
SELECT raceId, race_name, average_points, result_count, ratio
FROM ranked
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Higher side” of the 1.0-point dividing line means strictly greater than 1.0; results equal to 1.0 are excluded.
